## Scope and source notes

Account balance is camt052 v06 and account statement is camt053 v02. Migration to v08 is announced but not claimed as current availability. Direct camt053 sample has an invalid placeholder BICXXX, preserved unchanged. Docs also discuss UK hosting but sample market here is Estonia. No open redistribution license established; originals should remain external-only.

No open redistribution licence established. Consult the publisher before republishing originals.
